about:
Idaho Custom Woodwork operates from Boise, Idaho, as a locally owned limited liability company. The shop describes itself as a custom furniture maker and full-service repair and restoration specialist, with the principals citing over 35 years of combined experience in the trade. No founding year or individual founders are disclosed in the available materials.

The business builds indoor and outdoor furniture in styles that include farmhouse, modern, mission, and live-edge river tables, while also offering repair, restoration, custom color matching, veneering, and rebuilding of antique pieces. Work is performed on an appointment-only basis at the Boise shop; no facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers range from residential clients to commercial accounts across the Treasure Valley and wider Idaho region. The company notes projects such as dining sets with extendable leaves, coffee and end tables, bed sets, dressers, nightstands, and small cabinetry for both home and business settings.

The owners emphasize trust, personalized attention, and craftsmanship they describe as unmatched in beauty and durability. The shop also points to being voted best furniture maker and restoration company for 2024 through 2026 by a business-rating service as a mark of recognition.
